errorCodes.meaning: No endorsement type with the supplied typeUri is registered.

criteria.description: Identifiers of the admission criteria requiring statements of this type. Absent when the consumer has no criteria concept.

liveEndorsements.description: Count of unrevoked endorsements of this type. Absent when the consumer keeps no endorsement store of its own.

errorCodes.meaning: Something still references this type — a live endorsement of it, an admission criterion requiring statements of it, or both. `details` says which, and a consumer that can determine both SHOULD report both rather than making the caller clear one and discover the other.
